questions.answer: The level was lower than I expected. Perhaps the level in Copenhagen is just higher than usual.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: In the masters it is only lectures as it is in Copenhagen. The difference is that they use midterms and graded assignments at NOVA, which they dont in Copenhagen.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Financial Reporting, Financial Statement Analysis, Competition Policy, Strategy, Financial Management, Real Estate Finance.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Competition policy is very economics relevant, and highly recommendable. Financial reporting is the theoretical auditing, where financial statement analysis is the "real-life" version.
